q: Where do static keys and rotating Threads tokens live?
decision: Static keys in Secret Manager; rotating Threads tokens in an Admin-SDK-only Firestore collection
reason: Secret Manager bills per version and rotation churns versions; Firestore holds latest in place and is default-denied to clients.

q: Where to host public demo photos and rendered cards?
decision: Same Firebase Storage bucket, social/ prefix, public read on that prefix only
reason: App already uses Firebase Storage; no new bucket or serving code.

q: How does the server reach OpenAIClient?
decision: Move OpenAIClient and its models into shared/; decouple OlxCountry (secrets, platform call) from the prompt
reason: Server already depends on shared; avoids Compose in server image and a forked prompt.

q: How does the agent handle failures?
decision: Retry transient 3x; pause account and Telegram alert on non-transient 4xx or moderation flag; Cloud Monitoring alert on Scheduler failure
reason: A scale-to-zero service cannot report its own wake-up failure; the alert is console config with no code.

decision: Daily per-post insights, clicks and spend snapshots in Firestore, kept indefinitely
reason: Firestore is already the agent store; volume is negligible and BigQuery would solve an unobserved problem.
